abstract.text: Skein is a small, type-safe dependency-injection container for Swift.

inlineContent.text: Skein supports independently owned applications as well as a global convenience API. Its default API is MainActor-isolated, with explicit Sendable nonisolated and custom-global-actor alternatives.
